author: Te6ele

title: Distracting dashboard
body:
The progress dashboard has this For You section where there’s always a bunch of eye-grabbing attempts to upsell you. Just above that there’s always this bubblehead with some notification or suggestion for you - also in an attempt to upsell you or increase your usage of the app.

This makes landing on the app quite stressful and distracting. I love the look and feel of the app, it’s calming and feels in line with the mindful act of being intentional with one’s habits - or so it would be if the dashboard where you need to record each milestone wasn’t a mini Time Square Billboard showcase.

Ultimately, I find that this makes me far less likely to engage the app - especially when I’ve just hit a pre-bedtime milestone. 

If apps designed to reduce mental clutter, constant advertisements and help position you for sticking to your goals without constant pushing to add to that list of goals matters to you, then you’d best look elsewhere!

author: Bernard Rossouw

title: Useless
body: This app claims it will give you a report of the type of ADHD you have but it does NOT, it just gives you the same basic mainstream advice on “good habits.”  These are all non-specific and the same general advice you get from any generic self help book or quote on social media.  It is NOT specific or aimed for people with SDHD, do NOT waste your money or time on this useless generic unhelpful app.

title: Product does not work and poor customer service that takes over 15 days to respond to help cancel
body: Would not recommend this to anyone. I signed up for the 3 day trial and then a download back for over $20, the download booklet does not download on any device and you cannot get hold of anyone. I emailed and received a response saying there are delays and eventually cancelled my trial as could not get hold of anyone. Over 15 days later I receive a generic response saying my 3 day trial was successfully cancelled and did not get a response on my initial query around the download.

author: Dizzylola

title: Habio - fraudulent and unethical
body: Clicked on an ad for this app on social media, took the initial quiz and paid for the 1 week trial. Once the app was downloaded, I was forced to take the quiz again and choose a new plan/ subscription. Similar to the other review, I was charged R500 against my will. There’s no option to unsubscribe on the bottom of the emails, and the settings in the app shows no option to handle billing/subscription. The app preys on people who are trying to better themselves, and people who are trying to better their mental health. Not only does it show a lack of basic humanity on premise, it’s fraudulent and extremely unethical.

body: Hi all. I downloaded this app to try the 3 day trial, through this period I received notifications about the trial ending, which I duly got charged the full price (R500+ in SA rands).
